energy.page.load_mode_note.auto_calculat: No entity has the role “House consumption”, so it is calculated: PV + grid import + discharging − feed-in − charging. “Remaining consumption” is then a remainder, not a measurement.
energy.page.load_mode_note.auto_measured: Measured, because an entity has the role “House consumption” — otherwise it would be calculated.
energy.page.load_mode_note.calculated: House consumption = PV + grid import + discharging − feed-in − charging. “Remaining consumption” is a remainder here, not a measurement — it takes in every consumer that is not metered separately.
energy.page.load_mode_note.combined: Calculated, but measured consumers are shown separately. “House consumption” here means the measured sub-consumer, not the total — a whole-house meter on this role would be counted twice. “Remaining consumption” stays a remainder, not a measurement.
energy.page.load_mode_note.measured: House consumption comes directly from the entity with the role “House consumption”.
